title: 2 Heartwarming K-Dramas to Stream Today on Disney+: 'Merry Berry Love' and 'Between Steps' - Hashtag Legend Hong Kong
text:

 By Chayanit Nakiraks October 26, 2026 The most meaningful relationships in life do not always spring from grand gestures. Often, they begin with small acts of daily care, attentive listening, or simply having someone stand by your side when life does not go according to plan.
 For anyone seeking warmth to replenish the heart, Disney+ invites you to experience two fresh K-dramas that explore the nuances of human connection across two distinct moods—a heartwarming romantic comedy that brings a smile, and a comforting melodrama that gently heals the soul.
 ‘Merry Berry Love’ — When Love Requires Time and Attention 
 The romance between a Korean man and a Japanese woman unfolds on a serene little island in Japan. Yubin, a once-successful Korean spatial designer, faces a mid-life storm that leaves him with nothing, before fate brings him to meet Karin, a dedicated strawberry farmer.
 Though hailing from completely different worlds, with contrasting backgrounds and perspectives, their time shared together gradually melts away misunderstandings, opening the door for them to see and appreciate each other's true worth.
 The series offers a beautiful allegory comparing love to cultivating strawberries—a process that cannot be rushed, but demands time, patience, and consistent care. Feelings do not bloom overnight; rather, they are woven from daily attentiveness. The story also reflects on fresh starts and finding simple happiness in everyday moments often overlooked.
 ‘Between Steps’ — Comfort Found in Those Who Stand Beside You 
 Offering a different perspective, the melodrama ‘Between Steps’ explores the lives of Park Min-jae and Im Yu-jin, two young adults navigating pivotal transitions in life when their envisioned paths stray off course.
 Amidst the confusion and exhaustion, the series underscores the immense value of having someone who is truly ready to listen. Simple questions such as "Are you tired?" or "Are you doing okay?" can mean far more than imagined. Just knowing that we do not have to face the world alone makes difficult days remarkably lighter.
 Here, affection is communicated not through grand speeches, but through quiet presence—sitting close, holding hands, and listening deeply—offering a powerful source of strength to keep stepping forward, one step at a time.
 Though told through different contexts and emotional tones, both series deliver the same poignant message: the true value of love, care, and growing together. Immerse yourself in these uplifting journeys with “Merry Berry Love” and “Between Steps,” available to stream today with exclusive Thai dubbed options, only on Disney+.
